Feats.record_predicate: a record counts when a player-editable (VISIBLE QUALIFY|YES and EDITABLE:YES) category of this DISPLAYLOCATION in the corpus books spans it: same parent CATEGORY, and a shared TYPE (OR over the '.'-list) or a key in ABILITYLIST, or no filter; one record can count under several sub-tabs. 'pick-granted' narrows to categories some corpus record grants picks into (BONUS:ABILITYPOOL / CHOOSE:ABILITYSELECTION target) plus FEAT

class_granted_choices.unit: a choice site = one (granting record file, mechanism, target) triple; repeated tokens on one record for the same target (e.g. Rogue Talents' -1 adjustments) collapse to one site
class_granted_choices.granting_records_predicate: kind class or class_feature, or kind ability with CATEGORY Class/Archetype
class_granted_choices.granted_by_predicate: owner = key text before ' ~ '; archetype if CATEGORY Archetype or owner is an archetype name; class if owner is a class record name; else other

mechanisms.abilitypool: BONUS:ABILITYPOOL|<category>|<formula> (talents, tricks, rage powers, bloodline, mystery, order...)
mechanisms.domain_count: BONUS:DOMAIN|NUMBER|n (cleric/paladin/shaman/druid domain picks; selectable = domain records)
mechanisms.parameter_choose: any other CHOOSE (WEAPONPROFICIENCY, SKILL, SPELLS, CLASS, STRING...)
